lunch2_start.name: {name}
lunch2_start.text: *Lunchtime. Unlike yesterday, I have Yuna's note in my pocket. At the end of the hallway, Seoyeon is heading toward the rooftop with a lunchbox, and Dain is waving me toward the school store again.*

lunch2_choice.name: {name}
choices: Follow Yuna's note to the library annex
Go to the school store with Dain

lunch2_seo_1b.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_1b.text: *The rooftop. First time here. The breeze is cool and the view is wide open. Seoyeon is setting out her lunch.*

lunch2_seo_2b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b.text: You came all the way up here. Bold.

lunch2_seo_2b_dain.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_dain.text: Yesterday you were headed for the store. Today you came all the way up here.

lunch2_seo_3b_dain.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3b_dain.text: Dain dragged me off yesterday. Today, I wanted to come up here myself.

lunch2_seo_5b_dain.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5b_dain.text: The breeze is nice. And I kept thinking about your lunchbox.

lunch2_seo_2b_yuna.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_yuna.text: You got a note and still came to the rooftop.

lunch2_seo_3b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3b_yuna.text: Yesterday was the quiet option, so today I got curious about your side.

lunch2_seo_5b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5b_yuna.text: I wanted to know what this breeze and the president's lunchbox feel like together.

lunch2_dain_1b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b.text: *To the store with Dain. First rock-paper-scissors match.*

lunch2_dain_1b_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b_seo.text: *To the store with Dain. Yesterday it was a lunchbox. Today the smell of bread hits first.*

lunch2_dain_2b_seo.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2b_seo.text: Oh, so today it's my side instead of the president's lunchbox?!

lunch2_dain_3b_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3b_seo.text: Yesterday was the president's pace. Today I wanted to see your pace too.

lunch2_dain_4b_seo.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b_seo.text: Nice!! You can't take that back! One round with soboro on the line!!

lunch2_dain_1b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b_yuna.text: *To the store with Dain. Yesterday it was a quiet library. Today the smell of bread and the noise hit first.*

lunch2_dain_2b_yuna.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2b_yuna.text: Hey! Yesterday you were all shadow-quiet, and today you're actually here to play, right?!

lunch2_dain_3b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3b_yuna.text: If I went somewhere quiet, I should try somewhere loud too.

lunch2_dain_4b_yuna.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b_yuna.text: Nice!! I respect that sense of balance! Then let's go one round!!

lunch2_yuna_1.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_1.text: *The library annex. An older building than the main one. Almost no students around.*

lunch2_yuna_5_seo.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5_seo.text: Yesterday you were with the president.

lunch2_yuna_6_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_6_seo.text: Today you were the one who called me here.

lunch2_yuna_8_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8_seo.text: That made me want to come even more.

lunch2_yuna_4_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_4_yuna.text: You even sent me a note this time.

lunch2_yuna_5_yuna.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5_yuna.text: Yesterday was quiet too. Today as well?

lunch2_yuna_6_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_6_yuna.text: Yesterday was comfortable. So I came back.

lunch2_yuna_8_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8_yuna.text: Yeah. Sitting next to you wasn't as uncomfortable as I expected.

lunch2_yuna_7.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_7.text: You seem to be getting close with that loud one. That's more fun, isn't it?

lunch2_yuna_9.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_9.text: *Yuna smiles ever so slightly. Barely visible. — But I saw it. Did I come here just to see this smile?*

lunch2_yuna_11.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_11.text: *Yuna walks ahead. Deep into the annex. A place where no one seems likely to come.*

lunch2_yuna_13.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_13.text: What is this place? A secret reading room?

lunch2_yuna_14.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_14.text: ...Almost no one knows about this place.

lunch2_yuna_15.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_15.text: *Yuna sits on the sofa. She quietly leaves the spot next to her open.*

lunch2_yuna_16.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_16.text: There used to be one more person here.

lunch2_yuna_choice.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_choice.text: *Nothing follows 'used to be.' Past tense. — Should I ask?*
choices: That person, where are they now?
Don't ask and sit down next to her

lunch2_yuna_c1_4.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_4.text: *A shadow crosses Yuna's face. I don't know who that 'someone' was, but—*

lunch2_yuna_c1_6.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_6.text: ...I don't know. Whether they didn't, or couldn't.

lunch2_yuna_c1_7.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_7.text: *Yuna opens her book. A signal that the conversation is over.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_9.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_9.text: Did they have to leave suddenly? You know how it is, sometimes you miss calls or messages then.

lunch2_yuna_c1_12.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_12.text: *I messed up. Trying to brush it off only made it seem like I was trivializing her wound.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_14.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_14.text: *I always prided myself on being perceptive. — I was wrong. Not around this person.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_1.text: *I sit down next to her without a word. Yuna glances over briefly.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_4.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_4.text: *Offering a book instead of words. — This person's language is actions. Different from Seoyeon, but in its own way.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_8.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_8.text: It's quiet. — But I'm not alone.

lunch2_yuna_c2_9.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_9.text: *Two sentences. That's a long speech for Yuna. — And everything is packed into those two sentences.*

lunch2_yuna_end.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_end.text: *Yuna's 'used to be' lingers in my head. The meaning of this place she showed me... is slowly sinking in.*

lunch2_seo_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_1.text: *The rooftop. Same spot as yesterday. Seoyeon is setting out her lunchbox.*

lunch2_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2.text: You came again. Got a taste for it?

lunch2_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_4.text: Is it because of the food?

lunch2_seo_7.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_7.text: *She seemed like she wanted to hear more — but I deliberately held back.*

lunch2_seo_9.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_9.text: Oh! There you are?! Found you!

lunch2_seo_11.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_11.text: Come on, you don't need permission to eat. Oh, wait, a lunchbox! That looks amazing!

lunch2_seo_12.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_12.text: *Dain sits down without hesitation. Seoyeon's brow furrows ever so slightly.*

lunch2_seo_13.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_13.text: We met yesterday! Nice guy, Prez!

lunch2_seo_13b.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_13b.text: Oh! You're the president? Nice to meet you!

lunch2_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_14.text: *Looking in the direction Dain disappeared* ...She's got a lot of energy.

lunch2_seo_20.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_20.text: You have something on your lip. Hold still.

lunch2_seo_c1_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c1_1.text: *Seoyeon's finger brushes the corner of my lips. Softly. Slowly. — Slower than necessary.*

lunch2_seo_c1_5.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c1_5.text: *Three seconds for a grain of rice? — The tips of Seoyeon's ears are red.*

lunch2_seo_end_c1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_end_c1.text: *Where Seoyeon's hand passed still feels hot. — And Dain's surprised eyes keep coming back to me.*

lunch2_seo_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c2_1.text: *I wipe my mouth with the back of my hand.*

lunch2_seo_c2_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c2_2.text: ...If you do it yourself, you'll just make it worse.

lunch2_seo_c2_3.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c2_3.text: *She seems slightly miffed. — But her composure is flawless. That's so like her.*

lunch2_seo_end_c2.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_end_c2.text: *There's still a smudge on the back of my hand. Seoyeon's composure is flawless — but the corners of her lips have dipped just slightly.*

lunch2_dain_1.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1.text: *To the school store with Dain. A rematch of yesterday's rock-paper-scissors.*

lunch2_dain_2.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2.text: You're going down today!! Get ready!!

lunch2_dain_3.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3.text: You said the same thing yesterday.

lunch2_dain_8.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_8.text: Ah, alright... Two soboro bread, please...

lunch2_dain_9.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_9.text: *We buy bread and stand by the hallway windows. — Then Seoyeon walks by, carrying a lunchbox.*

lunch2_dain_10.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_10.text: *Seoyeon looks this way. She stares at me standing next to Dain, eating bread, for half a second — then walks past.*

lunch2_dain_11.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_11.text: Hey, what's with the president? Why's she staring?

lunch2_dain_13.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_13.text: Hmm... are you close with the president too?

lunch2_dain_choice.name: {name}
choices: She just showed me around the school?

lunch2_dain_c1_1.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_c1_1.text: *Dain's expression subtly stiffens. She takes a bite of soboro and turns her head away.*

lunch2_dain_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_c2_1.text: *Dain nods and takes a bite of soboro bread. Acting like she doesn't care.*

lunch2_dain_c3_1.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c3_1.text: W-what, don't laugh! *breaks soboro bread in half and shoves one piece over* ...Here, just eat this.

lunch2_dain_c3_2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_c3_2.text: *Her earlobes. Red. — The girls at this school have very honest ears.*

lunch2_dain_end.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end.text: *The crunching of Dain's soboro bread is unusually loud. Seoyeon's gaze, Dain's red ears — lunch period is getting more complicated by the day.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_9_ins.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_9_ins.text: *Yuna's gaze turns cold for an instant.*

lunch2_seo_c1_2_ins.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c1_2_ins.text: *Dain's eyes widen as she looks back and forth between the two of us.*

lunch2_seo_c1_3_ins.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c1_3_ins.text: *Acting like nothing happened* It was a grain of rice.

lunch2_dain_13_ins.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_13_ins.text: *Dain takes an exaggeratedly big bite of her soboro. Like the question she just asked wasn't a big deal.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins.text: *Fifth period PE. Running on the field when — the guy next to me stops short and we collide. My elbow gets scraped.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins3.name: PE Teacher
lunch2_dain_end_ins3.text: Go to the nurse's office and get it disinfected.

lunch2_dain_end_ins4.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins4.text: *I open the nurse's office door. Same antiseptic smell as yesterday.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins4_first.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins4_first.text: *I open the door to the nurse's office. An unfamiliar scent of antiseptic tickles my nose.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins5_first.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins5_first.text: *Inside the nurse's office. Documents are piled on the desk, and the nurse is sitting in her chair.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins7.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins7.text: Back again? Trying to become a regular?

lunch2_dain_end_ins7_first.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins7_first.text: ...Oh? You're the one from earlier. What brings you here during lunch?

lunch2_dain_end_ins8.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins8.text: *Same playful tone as yesterday. But her eyes are already examining the wound.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins8_first.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins8_first.text: *You look better than you did this morning. That's a relief.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins9.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins9.text: *The nurse comes over and takes my elbow. Her hands are cold.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins11.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins11.text: *She takes out a cotton ball soaked in antiseptic — dabs it carefully. Then pulls out a bandage.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins13.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins13.text: *Applying the bandage* Here... like this... there, done.

lunch2_dain_end_ins14.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins14.text: *The nurse's hand pauses. — 0.5 seconds. Then it moves again.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins15.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins15.text: ...My hands tend to be cold. Guess they're warm today.

lunch2_dain_end_ins16.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins16.text: *That's not true. When she first touched me, they were cold. — They only got warm just now.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins17.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins17.text: *Grinning* It's care. Real care. If you slap it on half-heartedly, it'll fall right off.

lunch2_dain_end_ins18.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins18.text: *Care... is that what it is? Or is there another reason?*

lunch2_dain_end_ins19.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins19.text: *Checking the bandage — I notice a laptop open on the desk. The screen shows something. Not medical records — more like a personal journal.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins21.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins21.text: *Narrowing her eyes* Just one? ...Hmm, fine then. I prefer cocoa over coffee. That's the secret.

lunch2_dain_end_ins22.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins22.text: *As secrets go, it's harmless enough. But the act of sharing it — that means something.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins23.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins23.text: *Laughs softly* Secret. Teachers get to have secrets too, you know.

lunch2_dain_end_ins24.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins24.text: *She plays it off with a joke, but she closed that laptop fast. — There's something she doesn't want seen.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins25.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins25.text: All done, so get back to class. — And next time, come without being hurt.

lunch2_dain_end_ins26.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins26.text: If I'm not hurt, I'd have no reason to come.

lunch2_dain_end_ins27.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins27.text: *The nurse pauses. And then — her voice drops a tone.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins28.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins28.text: You can come even without a reason.

lunch2_dain_end_ins29.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins29.text: *The playfulness is gone. — 0.5 seconds. Then it returns.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins30.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins30.text: *Brightening up again* Oh, but not during class. After school.

lunch2_dain_end_ins31.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins31.text: *That shift in her voice just now. — Was I imagining things?*

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short1.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short1.text: There, all done. Try not to get hurt next time.

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short2.text: *Got the bandage and left the nurse's office. — It felt more comfortable than it looked from outside.*

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short3.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short3.text: *I could probably come back after school.*
